map.算法：有效厚度 = 设计厚度 − 安全裕量；设计寿命 = 有效厚度/腐蚀速率；剩: Algorithm: effective thickness = design thickness minus safety margin; design life = effective thickness / corrosion rate; remaining life = design life minus years in service; consumed thickness = corrosion rate times years in service; remaining thickness = design thickness minus consumed thickness; health = remaining thickness / design thickness times 100%. Environment grade C1 to C5 (the tool environment factor 0.5 / 1 / 2 / 3 / 5) is used to recommend coating systems and condition hints: C1 to C2 primer plus topcoat (120 to 160 um), C3 zinc-rich primer plus epoxy plus topcoat (180 to 240 um), C4 to C5 zinc-rich primer plus epoxy mid-coat plus fluorocarbon topcoat (280 to 320 um).
